evidence.claim: The original Landiras first-estimate map depicts a burned-area thematic layer derived by visual interpretation of Sentinel-3 observations acquired on July 16 at 10:40 UTC.
evidence.locator: Page 1, map legend, Map Information and Data sources
evidence.review_scope: Source product inspected; conditional temporal bounding only. Human approval pending.

evidence.claim: The first-estimate product states a source GSD of 300 m, estimated geometric accuracy of 600 m or better, and a minimum mapping unit of 810000 square meters. It cannot establish parcel-level damage or road passability.
evidence.locator: Page 1, Map Information and Data sources; final sentence is a research limitation derived from the coarse product scope
evidence.review_scope: Source product inspected; conditional temporal bounding only. Human approval pending.

evidence.claim: The original La Teste-de-Buch first-estimate map shows a burned-area layer based on Sentinel-3 observations from July 16 at 10:40 UTC.

evidence.claim: The PDF records July 17 as map-production date, while the portal lists delivery on July 16 at 22:34:46 without a timezone. The calendar-date difference requires reconciliation and does not establish an exact publication instant.

evidence.review_scope: Source product inspected; conditional temporal bounding only. Human approval pending.

policy.rule: Interpret timezone-unspecified portal delivery over all offsets -12 through +14 hours. Lower bound is max(observation UTC, production-day UTC start, earliest possible delivery UTC). Conservative upper bound is max(production-day UTC end, latest possible delivery UTC). These are methodological bounds, not measured publication times.
policy.limitation: The bounds assume the portal delivery card relates to the downloaded version. This link is not historically verified. Never promote to strict responder-time replay or claim actual receipt by responders.

checkpoints.label: Early uncertainty check
checkpoints.rationale: Tests whether a product whose conservative release interval crosses midnight is correctly withheld.

checkpoints.label: Primary pilot cutoff
checkpoints.rationale: Conservative research checkpoint admitting only the Landiras first estimate after its upper bound, while withholding La Teste-de-Buch and the later delineation. Chosen for testing information separation, not an observed emergency decision time.

checkpoints.label: Later comparison
checkpoints.rationale: Compares documented source content after all three conservative upper bounds. Not a predictive outcome benchmark.
